comment: Golden vectors shared by the CameraStamp app (source: docs/verify/verify-vectors.json) and the web verifier (byte-identical copy: test/vectors/verify-vectors.json). The testKey is a PUBLIC TEST KEY, never a real one. All coordinates are synthetic. Regenerate in the app repo only; see docs/verify/README.md.

testKey.label: TEST KEY - public, d = SHA-256("camerastamp-test-key-v1") mod n; never use outside tests

generators.synth: x=i%w, y=i/w; R=(x*255/w + seed*13)&255; G=(y*255/h + seed*29)&255; B=((x/max(1,w/7) + y/max(1,h/5) + seed)%2==0) ? 40 : 210 (integer division)
